summary: Filtered item list iterator used by inventory, equipment, shop, and smith menus to walk and filter 4-byte item entries ({u16 itemId, u8 count, u8 flags}) from the ItemBag or generated tables.
evidence: Installs vtable 0x0076919C/0x007691A4 in ItemList_Iterator_Ctor (0x003C2358); embedded at +0x5C in Ui_ItemListCore and +0x74 in Ui_SmithMenu_SubObject; iterates 4-byte ItemBag entries filtered by Item_MatchesCategoryFilter (0x0064923C).

fields.name: vtable
fields.evidence: Virtual method table pointer (0x0076919C / 0x007691A4); installed in ItemList_Iterator_Ctor (0x003C2358) and overwritten in Ui_ItemListCore destructor (0x004E3FA8)

fields.name: entriesBegin
fields.evidence: Pointer to the beginning of the 4-byte item entry array (either from ItemBag at work+0x24ACC or from func_0061175C); set in ItemList_Iterator_Init (0x003C22B8)

fields.name: entriesEnd
fields.evidence: Past-the-end pointer of the 4-byte item entry array (entriesBegin + count * 4); set in ItemList_Iterator_Init (0x003C22C0) and serves as upper bound in iteration loops

fields.name: currentEntry
fields.evidence: Pointer to the current 4-byte item entry; initialized to entriesBegin - 4 and stepped forward by 4 in ItemList_Iterator_Init (0x003C225C) and Ui_ListCursor_MoveToSelectable (0x006E505C); dereferenced for u16 itemId at +0 (0x003C2334) and category/count byte at +2 (0x003C2240)

fields.name: currentIndex
fields.evidence: Logical index of current selectable/matching item; initialized to -1 (0xFFFFFFFF) in Ctor (0x003C237C) and Init (0x003C22CC), incremented each time an entry matches Item_MatchesCategoryFilter; tested against targetEntry in Ui_ListCursor_MoveToSelectable (0x006E505C)

fields.name: categoryFilter
fields.evidence: Item category filter selector (0x00..0x11); default 0x11 in Ctor (0x003C2384), passed to Item_MatchesCategoryFilter (0x0064923C) via ItemList_Iterator_Init (0x003C22B4) and Ui_ListCursor_MoveToSelectable
